# Taha Chelly

> Official personal website of Taha Chelly, a software engineer based in Sfax, Tunisia. He works at SpeakDuo on full-stack development and AI-powered language-learning experiences.

## Profile

- [Personal website](https://tahachelly.com/): Introduction, current work, selected skills, portrait, and contact links.

## Selected projects

- [Quranic Shazam](https://tahachelly.com/projects/quranic-shazam/): Identify Quran recitations from audio and explore the matching verse.
- [Qafiya](https://tahachelly.com/projects/qafiya/): Analyze Arabic poetry against classical meters, inspect rhyme, and add vocalization locally.
